name: SkilzVolt
description:
SkilzVolt gives authenticated AI agents access to a company-governed library of reusable skills. Agents can discover approved skills, read their current workspace-authored content and resources, and propose new skills or version-pinned amendments. Every write follows the workspace's configured review policy and produces durable status, lineage, and audit evidence. Agents can also assess existing skills for migration and request that an eligible personal skill be transferred into a company workspace; transfer acceptance remains an explicit human decision. Access is recalculated from the connecting user's current workspace membership on every request.

What users need before connecting: An active SkilzVolt account with legal terms accepted and access to at least one workspace. Read-only connections can discover and retrieve approved material. Creating proposals, submitting eligible agentic reviews, migration operations, and transfer requests requires a read/write connection and the corresponding current workspace role.

_published_faq.name: How do I add SkilzVolt to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add SkilzVolt to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://app.skilzvolt.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the SkilzVolt MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: SkilzVolt lists 22 MCP tools, including connection_diagnostic, fetch, search, skills_catalogue, skills_check_pending, skills_create, skills_export_all, skills_get, skills_get_proposal_diff, skills_get_resource, skills_migration_preview, and skills_migration_recover.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to SkilzVolt?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to SkilzVolt in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
SkilzVolt requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
SkilzVolt is developed by SEER Innovations Ltd. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
